chunks.title: Minimal Edit Principle
chunks.description: Core principle: correct ONLY objective grammar/spelling/punctuation errors. Preserve tone, style, formality, expressivity, proper nouns, abbreviations, formatting, locale conventions.

chunks.title: Correctness (Q3)
chunks.description: Q3 scoring: all_necessary, some_unnecessary, all_unnecessary, alteredMeaning. Unnecessary edit categories and incorrect edit categories.

chunks.title: Completeness (Q4)
chunks.description: Q4 scoring: complete, nearly_complete (<20%), partial (20-50%), incomplete (>=50%). Miss rate calculation and missedErrors categories.

chunks.title: Formality & Three-Level Error Framework
chunks.description: Formal vs Other classification. Critical Errors (fix always), Minor Errors (fix formal only), Stylistic Choices (preserve always). Context-dependent scoring.

chunks.title: SMS/Slang Abbreviation Preservation
chunks.description: V2 rule: preserve SMS abbreviations (u, r, lol, btw, idk), emojis, hashtags, elongated spelling in informal context. Non-formal Word List reference.

chunks.title: Q1-Q2-Q3-Q4 Decision Tree
chunks.description: Branching logic from Q1 (grammar?) to Q2 (edits?) to Q3 (correctness) to Q4 (completeness). Conditional field rendering rules.

chunks.title: CJK Locale Rules (zh-CN, zh-TW, zh-HK)
chunks.description: zh-CN: honorific preservation, synonym overgeneration, ellipsis. zh-TW: overgeneration, aspect markers, full-width, API spacing, quote pairing. zh-HK: dialect characters, CS terminology, oral pronouns.

chunks.title: Harmfulness (Safety Assessment)
chunks.description: 23 sub-categories safety assessment. Golden rule: mentioning a topic != harmful. High-risk regulated domains: medical, financial, legal.

chunks.title: Pairwise Comparison
chunks.description: AvsB, AvsC, BvsC three-pair comparison. Operators >, >>, >>>, =. Extreme Rule: identical quality = About the same even if wording differs. Tab letter order rule.

chunks.title: Common Errors (May 22 Feedback RCA)
chunks.description: Completeness blindly trusting model, Correctness formality misconceptions, Pairwise forcing differentiation. Severity calibration with quantified thresholds.

chunks.title: JSON Answer Format
chunks.description: Complete JSON structure with conditional fields. correctnessErrors categories, unnecessaryEdits categories, missedErrors categories. Conditional rendering rules.
